race.comment: MISS BLACK BETTY (11) has the strongest winning case, with her Wyong sixth better than it reads after she was bumped, blocked early and not fully ridden out, yet still picked up nicely late. Her run in the G3 Reginald Allen Quality on Everest Day also gives her form some depth for a Maiden. Ready to get off the mark at start six. RATIFY (4) was disappointing as favourite at Wyong, but his Rosehill third behind Italian Spirit two starts back is a solid reference and Kerrin McEvoy staying with him is a plus. Will be strong late. MOORDYUP (10) has to rebound from a plain Hawkesbury eighth, but her Kembla Grange fifth beaten a length and a half reads competitively. Placed at this track and will relish this distance range. GOLDEN PRINCESS (9) improved effort from the low gate with a fighting second at Gosford as fav over 1600m. Sticky draw today and place claims look best.
